observedHarnessImprovements: Typed mathematical storyboard concepts eliminate prose-only algebra slides while preserving model-authored lesson content.
Exact storyboard and asset hash checks permit UI-only repair to reuse the existing104-second movie.
Ready-plan Jev eligibility no longer permits an unsupported stop before a proved read-only continuation. The1.367-second failed run is retained.
Creative review is scoped to each supplied image: film contact sheet does not fail because separately reviewed UI screenshots are absent. The64.232-second false-negative review run is retained.
Actual production CSP audits caught broken sound-from-zero, print/export promises and chapter behavior that simple screenshot checks missed.
limitations: The identity hero typesets A⁻¹A=I; supporting film caption states either round trip and companions explicitly give both A⁻¹A=AA⁻¹=I. Showing both in the hero would improve standalone pedagogy but no incorrect claim is present.
The worked inverse uses an inversion arrow without A/A⁻¹ labels; its title, exact entries, determinant and adjacent transcript clarify the operation.

Geometry grid and arrows are smaller/fainter than equation heroes. They are readable at native/fullscreen; mobile needs the requested adjacent readalong. Do not infer small-screen formula readability solely from the full-size frame review.

Music was verified by decoded waveform and playback metadata, not a subjective listening assessment. Measurable motion was found in2of3 runtime samples; the mostly settled opening title did not meet the content-band MAD threshold.
The status “Ready. Music optional.” is mildly ambiguous but the page explicitly says instrumental music/no narration and the sound toggle works. Listening is optional; score presence is verified.
Native browser controls temporarily cover lower film copy while visible; the adjacent readalong preserves the complete teaching text and fullscreen exposes the native landscape composition.
